data_description.account: Email address, username, or phone number. Vietnamese numbers may be entered as 0912345678, 912345678, or +84912345678; they are normalized automatically.
data_description.password: The HiEasy account password. Device passwords are read from the account device list.
data_description.region: Auto probes all server regions and stores the first successful region.

user.description: Sign in once. The integration imports cameras from the account, discovers them on the LAN, and obtains RTSP through vendor CGI, ONVIF, or a bounded direct RTSP probe.
user.title: Connect HiEasy account

data_description.discover_lan: Use WS-Discovery and a bounded subnet scan when cloud metadata has no LAN address.
data_description.lan_hosts: Optional comma-separated exact camera IP addresses or hostnames. These are tried before scanning a subnet.
data_description.lan_networks: Optional comma-separated CIDR networks, for example 192.168.1.0/24. Leave blank to derive local /24 networks.
data_description.max_scan_hosts: Safety limit across all configured networks.
data_description.rtsp_paths: Comma-separated relative paths. Supports the channel, channel02, stream, subtype, and profile placeholders shown in the default value.
data_description.rtsp_ports: Comma-separated direct RTSP ports, normally 554 or 8554.
data_description.scan_ports: Comma-separated HTTP / ONVIF ports, for example 80,81,8000,8080,8899.
data_description.scan_timeout: Timeout in seconds for local HTTP, ONVIF, and RTSP requests.
data_description.update_interval: How often local status and stream URLs are refreshed.
